title: Integrating AI Coding Agents Into Scientific Research
abstract: arXiv:2611.23334v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: New software tools have emerged that enable AI agents to quickly develop code that analyzes data and generates figures, but their mistakes can also harm a researcher's computer, require extensive resources for validation, and cause the results to be received more skeptically. These concerns could be mitigated if scientific software is developed in a secure environment with a system for monitoring file changes and well-defined standards for handling AI agents. This paper first describes how coding agents change eleven aspects of generating, verifying, and reproducing numerical results. A six-level scale is then proposed for classifying AI-assisted numerical experiments by their provenance, reproducibility, openness, oversight, and falsifiability (PROOF). The scale begins with locally self-consistent, version-controlled, human-verified results and culminates in a publicly accessible and curated archive of the files, change history, prompt

translated_title: 将AI编程智能体融入科学研究
translated_abstract: 新的软件工具已经出现，使AI智能体能够快速开发用于分析数据和生成图表的代码，但智能体犯的错误也可能损害研究人员的计算机，需要大量资源进行验证，并使研究结果受到更多质疑。如果科学软件在安全环境中开发，并配备监控文件变更的系统以及明确的AI智能体处理标准，这些顾虑可以得到缓解。本文首先描述了编程智能体如何改变生成、验证和重现数值结果的十一个方面。随后，论文提出了一套六级分类标准（PROOF），用于根据来源可追溯性、可重现性、开放性、监督性和可证伪性对AI辅助数值实验进行分类。该标准从本地自洽、版本受控、经人工验证的结果起步，最终达到可公开访问且经过整理的文件、变更历史和提示词归档。
tldr: 本文提出了PROOF六级分类标准，用于按来源可追溯性、可重现性、开放性、监督性和可证伪性对AI辅助数值实验进行分级，以指导在安全环境中将AI编程智能体整合进科学研究。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a six-level PROOF scale for classifying AI-assisted numerical experiments by provenance, reproducibility, openness, oversight, and falsifiability, guiding the secure integration of AI coding agents into scientific research.
